about_the_game:
Nothorian: The Eternal Conflict between Heaven and Hell

At the dawn of creation, when the cosmos was still a blank canvas, two opposing forces arose: the Gods, guardians of light and life, and the Lords of Hell, embodiments of darkness and destruction. For eons, these two factions waged an endless war, a cycle of epic battles that shook the foundations of reality.

The Gods, with their divine power and mastery of creation, often emerged victorious from these clashes. However, their nature was tied to the very fabric of the universe, and over time, this fabric began to weaken, taking the power of the Gods with it. Unlike them, the Lords of Hell possessed a sinister quality: the ability to rise from their ashes, again and again, after each defeat.

The Age of Divine Twilight

In the current era, the cosmic balance has tilted dangerously. The heavens, once bastions of divine power, have darkened, and the Gods, weakened by the passage of time and the wear and tear of countless battles, stand on the brink of extinction. The Lords of Hell, sensing the vulnerability of their eternal enemies, have seized this opportunity to unleash their fury upon the mortal world.

Hordes of demons and infernal creatures emerge from the depths, wreaking havoc and destruction in their wake. Mortal realms, once protected by divine vigilance, now find themselves at the mercy of dark forces.

The Awakening of Heroes

Faced with the imminent threat of annihilation, the Gods, in a final act of desperation, extend their waning power to mortals. They bestow divine blessings upon those who demonstrate courage and purity of heart, granting them the ability to stand against the Lords of Hell and their legions.

Bearers of hope in a world on the brink of the abyss, these blessed heroes stand as the last line of defense against the darkness. Their mission: to repel the infernal invasion, restore cosmic balance, and if possible, find a way to return the fallen gods to their power.

Nothorian is an action-adventure MMORPG set in a vast, dark world where despair and courage battle for supremacy.

Explore the regions of Talanar, Nuteron, and Aeronian—from the withered hills to the fields of eternal ice—as you uncover the secrets that led to Nothorian's doom.

From the sacred city of Venzor, birthplace of all heroes, players will embark on an epic journey to challenge the Lords of Hell and the ancient dragons that hold the key to destiny.

Face spectral foes, corrupted creatures, and forgotten horrors while improving your power through a dynamic combat system, unique abilities, and decisions that shape the course of the story.

🌑 Key Features:

  • A dark and detailed open world filled with cities, dungeons, and ancient secrets.

  • Four playable characters with unique combat styles.

  • Epic battles against legendary dragons and demonic entities.

  • Living History: Each update will expand the world and its story.

  • Exploration, intense combat, customization, and special events.

Will you be the hero who closes the Gate of Hell... or just another forgotten echo among the Nothorian ruins?
